name: Proposal Magic Link Request (Expired)
description: Guest who lands on an expired proposal submits their email to receive a fresh magic-link via the form in ProposalExpired.vue. Calls POST /api/proposals/request-link/ with { email } and shows a neutral confirmation message ('Si tenemos propuestas asociadas a ese email, recibirás un enlace en breve.') regardless of backend outcome to avoid leaking which emails are clients. Out of scope of proposal-expired-graceful (which covers the expired-state UI).
